layers.note: A shrub of moist lowland woods, forest edges and stream banks.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 600 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

max_slope_deg.note: Grows on flats and moderate slopes.

shade_tolerance.note: Grows in part shade under deciduous and mixed canopy.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set niche values

provenance.notes: Authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands; not yet checked against the public-domain USDA references (Silvics of North America, the Fire Effects Information System, PLANTS).
